summary: Iteration 54 — Team Hub Phase C: Roster feature. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass covering CRUD, name-required 400, invalid-role 422, 404 unknown, import-candidates shape, and idempotent import (dedupe by linked_id). Frontend: full flow verified on mobile viewport (375x812) end-to-end using the Apple review account — Team Hub shows tappable Roster card, Gifts & Meals + Waivers show COMING SOON and are non-tappable, roster-add form fills+saves and person appears, tapping a row opens edit prefilled and Save updates in place, delete removes, and the 'Add from my household' sheet lists exactly 2 athletes (Ava Johnson, Coach Maria) + 1 household member (App Review). Importing Ava + App Review adds them; reopening the sheet hides them and only Coach Maria remains (no duplicates). Money/Expenses regression clean: enter-select-mode, select-cancel, select-all-btn, add-money-entry, and home-btn all present and functional after the Select button was made icon-only. All test data was cleaned up via API.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/roster.py update_roster_member returns 400 when payload has no updatable fields — matches other routers, fine.
roster.py list uses (name).lower() sort — matches spec 'sorted by name'.
roster-new.tsx re-fetches full /roster list to find the edited row (line 37) — works but is O(n); acceptable for small rosters.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. All 3 rows created during testing (1 manual + 2 imported) were deleted via API after tests. Review household finished with 0 roster rows, ready for review.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Roster endpoints: GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/roster and GET /api/roster/import-candidates + POST /api/roster/import (household-scoped, auth required). Review household has 2 athletes (Ava Johnson id=40b0c66e..., Coach Maria id=ab4c1610...) and 1 household user (App Review id=a23cc392...). Always DELETE any rows you create so review acct stays clean.
